metas.name: Enna Vilai
metas.description: A humble fisherman from Rameswaram lives a quiet life with his family until he finds a gold pendant washed ashore. What initially seems like a blessing soon turns into a nightmare when false accusations threaten his peace and dignity, forcing him to stand up against a powerful system.

metas.name: #Home
metas.description: Oliver Twist (Indrans) wants to be tech-savvy and become a better companion to his two sons, who spend more time on their phones than with their loved ones.

metas.name: Kadaisi Vivasayi
metas.description: The last active farmer in a remote village tries to hold out against a property developer.

metas.name: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
metas.description: A cyborg from the future, identical to the one who failed to kill Sarah Connor, must now protect her ten-year-old son John from an even more advanced and powerful cyborg.

metas.name: Dhurandhar The Revenge
metas.description: Jaskirat Singh Rangi descends deeper into his alias as Hamza Ali Mazari, rising through Karachi's criminal hierarchy to claim the feared title "Sher-e-Baloch" while balancing loyalty, betrayal, and survival in a ruthless underworld.

metas.name: Video
metas.description: Video is a found footage, Docudrama by Srinidhi Bengaluru that stars Dheekshith Shetty, Bharatha, Jeevan Shivakumar, Tejesh S M, Priya J Achar, Nalme Nachiyar.

metas.name: Agent Sai Srinivasa Athreya
metas.description: Agent Sai Srinivasa Athreya is an authentic humorous investigative thriller revolving around the adventures of a detective based out of Nellore.

metas.name: Shershaah
metas.description: Shershaah is the story of PVC awardee Indian soldier Capt. Vikram Batra, whose bravery and unflinching courage in chasing the Pakistani soldiers out of Indian territory contributed immensely in India finally winning the Kargil War...

metas.name: Dhurandhar
metas.description: A mysterious traveler slips into the heart of Karachi's underbelly and rises through its ranks with lethal precision, only to tear the notorious ISI-Underworld nexus apart from within.

metas.name: Lucia
metas.description: A man suffering from insomnia is tricked into buying a drug, Lucia, that makes his desires come true in his dreams, blurring the line between fantasy and reality.

metas.name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu No Yaiba Infinity Castle
metas.description: The Demon Slayer Corps are drawn into the Infinity Castle, where Tanjiro and the Hashira face terrifying Upper Rank Hindi mein demons in a desperate fight as the final battle against Muzan Kibutsuji begins.

metas.name: Project Hail Mary
metas.description: A science teacher wakes up alone on a spaceship. As his memory returns, he uncovers a mission to stop a mysterious substance killing Earth's sun, and realizes that an unexpected friendship may be the key.

metas.name: EPiC: Elvis Presley in Concert
metas.description: Follows Elvis Presley, featuring never-before-seen footage and recordings.

metas.name: K.G.F: Chapter 2
metas.description: In the blood-soaked Kolar Gold Fields, Rocky's name strikes fear into his foes, while the government sees him as a threat to law and order. Rocky must battle threats from all sides for unchallenged supremacy.

metas.name: It's the Great Pumpkin, Charlie Brown
metas.description: The Peanuts gang celebrates Halloween while Linus waits for the Great Pumpkin.

metas.name: Drishyam
metas.description: Desperate measures are taken by a man who tries to save his family from the dark side of the law, after they commit an unexpected crime.

metas.name: Kahaani
metas.description: A pregnant woman's search for her missing husband takes her from London to Kolkata, but everyone she questions denies having ever met him.

metas.name: Spider-Man: No Way Home
metas.description: Peter Parker turns to Doctor Strange after his identity destroys the life he knows, but a magical mistake draws powerful outsiders into his world and forces him to confront what being Spider Man really means.

metas.name: Wild Tales
metas.description: Six short stories that explore the extremities of human behavior involving people in distress.

metas.name: How to Train Your Dragon
metas.description: A hapless young Viking who aspires to hunt dragons becomes the unlikely friend of a young dragon himself, and learns there may be more to the creatures than he assumed.

metas.name: Mad Max: Fury Road
metas.description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in search for her homeland with the aid of a group of female prisoners, a psychotic worshipper and a drifter named Max.

metas.name: Spider-Man: Brand New Day
metas.description: A forgotten Peter Parker lives alone as a full-time Spider-Man until mounting pressure triggers a dangerous change and a powerful new enemy emerges.

metas.name: Maqbool
metas.description: The intrigue of the Shakespearean tragedy 'Macbeth' is transposed to the Mumbai underworld.

metas.name: Donnie Darko
metas.description: After narrowly escaping a bizarre accident, a troubled teenager is plagued by visions of a man in a large rabbit suit who manipulates him to commit a series of crimes.

metas.name: Shrek
metas.description: A mean lord exiles fairytale creatures to the swamp of a grumpy ogre, who must go on a quest and rescue a princess for the lord in order to get his land back.

metas.name: The Nightmare Before Christmas
metas.description: Jack Skellington, king of Halloween Town, discovers Christmas Town, but his attempts to bring Christmas to his home causes confusion.

metas.name: Natsamrat
metas.description: The film is the story of an actor who has reached many heights in his career but has to retire from acting at the peak.

metas.name: Veer-Zaara
metas.description: An Indian Air Force pilot rescues a Pakistani girl stranded in India. Years later, a lawyer seeks to unravel the truth behind the pilot's mysterious imprisonment in Pakistan for over two decades, during which he remained silent.

metas.name: The Batman
metas.description: When a sadistic serial killer begins murdering key political figures in Gotham, the Batman is forced to investigate the city's hidden corruption and question his family's involvement.

metas.name: Obsession
metas.description: After breaking the mysterious "One Wish Willow" to win his crush's heart, a hopeless romantic finds himself getting exactly what he asked for but soon discovers that some desires come at a dark, sinister price.

metas.name: The Social Network
metas.description: As Harvard student Mark Zuckerberg creates the social networking site that would become known as Facebook, he is sued by the twins who claimed he stole their idea and by the co-founder who was later squeezed out of the business.

metas.name: The Bourne Identity
metas.description: A man is picked up by a fishing boat, bullet-riddled and suffering from amnesia, before racing to elude assassins and attempting to regain his memory.

metas.name: Awaara
metas.description: A poor young man named Raj joins a criminal gang to feed his mother. But when he falls in love with Rita, he decides to reform himself for her.

metas.name: Avane Srimannarayana
metas.description: In the pursuit of solving an ancient mystery of Amaravati, Narayana, a corrupt cop must battle the dangerous clan of dacoits and it's fierce leader.

metas.name: Tenzing
metas.description: The untold and inspiring tale of one of the most important mountain climbers in history who, with Edmund Hillary, became the first person to reach the summit of Mount Everest.

metas.name: Ohm Shanthi Oshaana
metas.description: A spirited young girl would stop at nothing to get the first love of her life, even if it takes seven years and several heartbreaks.

metas.name: Delhi Belly
metas.description: Three struggling room-mates unknowingly become potential prey of a ruthless gangster.

metas.name: Minority Report
metas.description: John works with the PreCrime police which stop crimes before they take place, with the help of three 'PreCogs' who can foresee crimes. Events ensue when John finds himself framed for a future murder.

metas.name: Ek Hasina Thi
metas.description: A woman falls for a charming and mysterious businessman. The whirlwind romance turns sour when she is framed for his underworld crimes. Now, finally out of prison she is ready for sweet revenge.

metas.name: Furiosa: A Mad Max Saga
metas.description: After being snatched from the Green Place of Many Mothers, while the tyrants Dementus and Immortan Joe fight for power and control, the young Furiosa must survive many trials as she puts together the means to find her way home.

metas.name: Dracula
metas.description: Centuries-old vampire Count Dracula comes to England to seduce his barrister Jonathan Harker's fiancée Mina Murray and wreak havoc in the foreign land.

metas.name: Robber
metas.description: An aristocrat's daughter falls in love with a visiting archaeologist, but he holds a secret that could drive them apart.

metas.name: O Kadhal Kanmani
metas.description: Two young lovers are compatible in every way - they even agree that marriage is futile. However, their emotions are not so easily managed, especially when they witness the unconditional love of the older couple with whom they live.

metas.name: Malena
metas.description: As Italy enters WWII, a teenage boy in a small, narrow-minded Sicilian town becomes obsessed with a young woman.

metas.name: Gold
metas.description: The journey of a man who was instrumental in making India win its first Olympic gold medal as a free nation.

metas.name: Mrs. Chatterjee vs. Norway
metas.description: An immigrant Indian mother's battle against the Norwegian foster care system and local legal machinery to win back the custody of her children.

metas.name: The Life of Chuck
metas.description: A life-affirming, genre-bending story about three chapters in the life of an ordinary man named Charles Krantz.

metas.name: Hum Hain Rahi Pyar Ke
metas.description: Rahul Malhotra (Aamir Khan) is the manager of the heavily in debt family business. He is also the guardian of his dead sister's mischievous kids. Rahul hires Vaijayanti (Juhi Chawla) as governess. Vaijayanti is a runaway from home...

metas.name: Gupt: The Hidden Truth
metas.description: Governor Jaisingh Sinha is murdered and the needle of suspicion points towards his estranged son, Sahil Sinha who must prove his innocence.

metas.name: Vishwanath and Sons
metas.description: Sanjay Vishwanath has devoted decades to excellence as an international shooter. When age, family duties, and an unexpected romance collide with his ambitions, he must confront what truly makes a life worth living.
